title: SAG-Sep: Sparse Augmented Graphs and Onion-Guided Search for Rounded Capacity Cut Separation
abstract: arXiv:2610.37952v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rounded capacity cuts (RCCs) are among the most effective cuts for capacitated vehicle-routing relaxations, but exact separation is computationally prohibitive at scale. Existing heuristic and neural separators can be fast, but often fail to produce sufficiently many effective cuts within practical separation budgets. We introduce SAG-Sep, a separator that scores node membership in RCC-inducing subsets across vehicle-count levels from a fractional LP solution in a single encoder forward pass, avoiding the iterative predict-and-coarsen inference used by NeuralSEP-style separators. SAG-Sep encodes the LP solution as a Sparse Augmented Graph (SAG), adding flow-informed multi-hop edges that expose long-range routing structure without densifying attention. Beyond LP-aware sparse encoding, we observe that high-value exact RCCs are typically nested, organizing into onion-like subset families, and SAG-Sep's node scores track subset nesting dep

translated_title: SAG-Sep：用于舍入容量割分离的稀疏增强图与洋葱引导搜索
translated_abstract: 舍入容量割（RCC）是带容量约束车辆路径问题松弛中最有效的割之一，但在大规模场景下，精确分离的计算代价令人望而却步。现有的启发式和神经分离器虽然速度较快，但在实际分离时间预算内往往难以产生足够多的有效割。我们提出SAG-Sep，一种新型分离器：它通过单次编码器前向传播，从分数LP解中针对不同车辆数量层级对诱导RCC的子集进行节点隶属度评分，从而避免了NeuralSEP类分离器所采用的迭代式“预测-粗化”推理。SAG-Sep将LP解编码为稀疏增强图（SAG），添加由流信息驱动的多跳边，在不稠密化注意力机制的前提下揭示长程路径结构。除了LP感知的稀疏编码之外，我们还观察到高价值的精确RCC通常呈嵌套结构，组织为洋葱状的子集族，而SAG-Sep的节点评分能够追踪子集的嵌套深度……
tldr: SAG-Sep将LP解编码为稀疏增强图并在单次前向传播中完成节点评分，结合洋葱引导搜索，为大规模车辆路径问题快速分离出大量有效舍入容量割。
en_tdlr: SAG-Sep encodes LP solutions as sparse augmented graphs to score RCC-inducing node subsets in a single forward pass, and leverages onion-guided search to rapidly separate abundant effective rounded capacity cuts for large-scale vehicle-routing relaxations.
